_about: Public-domain Charles Chapman Grafton (1830-1912), Cowley Father and Episcopal Bishop of Fond du Lac, Anglo-Catholic leader, for the Word Hoard: The Works of the Rt. Rev. Charles C. Grafton (8 vols., 1914), which gather his books (Christian and Catholic, The Lineage from Apostolic Times, A Catholic Atlas, Pusey and the Church Revival, A Journey Godward, his sermons and devotional writings). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 92 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
